# Manndev

> Custom websites and web apps built from scratch in Montréal. No templates, no page builders: just clean, fast code you own outright.

Manndev is a small web design and development studio in Montréal, Québec, founded by Julien Mann and working remotely worldwide. Every project is hand-coded (no templates, no page builders), with a focus on performance, accessibility, and code the client owns outright.

## Services

- [Design & Development](https://manndev.com/#services): Landing pages and full websites, designed and hand-coded from scratch, with mockups before any code. Code, hosting and accounts belong to the client.
- [Hosting & Security](https://manndev.com/#services): Hosting, domain, SSL, business email, Cloudflare CDN, uptime monitoring every 5 minutes, automated backups, security updates and Law 25 compliance.
- [Search & Visibility](https://manndev.com/#services): SEO setup, local SEO and Google Maps, Google Business Profile management, AI search optimization and a monthly report.
- [Automation](https://manndev.com/#services): Bilingual AI chatbot for FAQs, hours and menus, online booking with reminders, and review requests, replies and monitoring.
- [Care plan](https://manndev.com/#principles): Monthly care for launched sites: managed hosting on a global CDN, uptime monitoring, security and dependency patches, content updates and bug fixes.
